title: IGFBP7-targeting monoclonal antibodies attenuate the endothelial inflammatory niche in psoriasis-like inflammation.
snippet: Psoriasis is sustained by immune-endothelial interactions that support leukocyte recruitment into inflamed skin. We previously showed that endothelial IGFBP7 disrupts the glycocalyx and promotes T-cell extravasation. Here, we developed and compared monoclonal antibodies against human IGFBP7.
